_comment: Levels, labels and customs [VERIFY] with a teacher of the country before the preset is advertised (PLAN.md 9.41). Liceu (teoretic, tehnologic or vocațional) from the clasa a IX-a to the a XII-a, written a IX-a A; the ciclul inferior (IX-X) and the ciclul superior (XI-XII) are not told apart. Pupils come from the a VIII-a of ro-gimnaziala (admission after the evaluarea națională, so the classes are formed anew) [VERIFY]. A liceu that also teaches the gimnaziu (colegiu, liceu with all grades) needs the levels of ro-gimnaziala added; the clasa a XIII-a of the technological and evening courses (seral, frecvență redusă) is not included [VERIFY]. The class names are often tied to the specialisation (a IX-a A matematică-informatică, B științe ale naturii…) [VERIFY]. The school year starts on 1 September, as in ro-gimnaziala [VERIFY]. After the a XII-a a pupil leaves (bacalaureat).
